verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE documents generating an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack, which covers the drafting-from-timeline step. Nothing describes the rest of a structured postmortem workflow; status pages and Slack sync are separate features and are not evidence of postmortem publication. missing for 10: postmortem templates, review/approval workflow, postmortem publication/sharing, independent or hands-on corroboration of the automated post-mortem quality.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, postmortems follow a real workflow — templates, drafting from the timeline, review, and publication

citations.quote: Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
